subject.title: gateway: malformed managed image data URLs can stall reply handling

question: Should maintainers land the public linear parser fix for this gateway ReDoS-style availability report, or route the issue through security handling before merge?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and already represented by open closing PRs, but the failure mode is an event-loop stall from crafted model-supplied media input on a stable gateway path.

options.title: Land after security-aware review
options.body: Proceed with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102825 once a gateway/security owner accepts the public handling route and validation semantics.

options.title: Route through security handling
options.body: Pause public landing and handle the denial-of-service report through the repository security process if coordinated handling is required.

options.title: Keep owner-owned until PR proof completes
options.body: Leave the issue open while the maintainer PR finishes exact-head proof and CI without starting another automated fix branch.
